Extract interaction distances between two point clouds.

Source: R/extract_interaction.R
extract_interaction.Rd

Calculates the nearest neighbor distances between two point clouds in both directions, returning either a numeric vector of the distances used to compute the coi with coi() or the interaction point cloud with distances as a fourth column.

Usage

extract_interaction(cloud_i, cloud_j, d_max, returns = c("distances", "cloud"))

Arguments

cloud_i

First point cloud as a matrix-like object.

cloud_j

Second point cloud as a matrix-like object.

d_max

Numeric of the maximum distance to consider for nearest neighbor search.

returns

Character, either "distances" (default) to return a vector of distances (to use in calculate_coi()), or "cloud" to return the combined cloud with distances (useful when extracted interaction point cloud needs to be inspected visually).

Value

Either a numeric vector of distances or a point cloud as a matrix with columns "x", "y", "z", "distance".

Examples

sphere1 <- gen_sphere(1, 0.05, c(0, 0, 0))
sphere2 <- gen_sphere(1, 0.05, c(0, 0.5, 0))
spheres_dists <- extract_interaction(sphere1, sphere2, d_max = 0.5)
